title: Tauri Shared Shell and Electron Retirement

preflight.note: Created before Tauri implementation work starts. Captures the operator decision to make Tauri 2 the target shared desktop/mobile shell and retire Electron after parity.

acceptance_criteria.text: Record the Tauri 2 target architecture: one shared React/Web UI for desktop and mobile, Rust-native shell logic, platform plugins where needed, desktop as source of truth, and Electron treated as a temporary compatibility shell.

Introduce a narrow app-bridge abstraction so renderer code does not directly depend on Electron APIs for local service control, notifications, secure storage, deep links, updater/distribution hooks, or mobile decision actions.

Scaffold a Tauri 2 desktop shell alongside Electron using the existing React renderer, with parity smoke tests for startup, authenticated local API access, settings/onboarding entry, notifications, and the Decisions/People/Agents/Channels cockpit.

Define and implement the Tauri 2 mobile decision-terminal path for Android/iOS: paired device, redacted alerts, approval cards, signed approve/deny/defer/request-more-info/short-reply decisions, presence signal, emergency toggle, and device revoke without private database replication.

Define the Electron retirement gate: Tauri must cover onboarding, local service lifecycle, credential storage, notifications, deep links, updates/distribution, diagnostics, data safety, and existing desktop workflows before Electron is removed.

Define the signed distribution and update strategy for Tauri desktop and mobile targets, coordinating with work item 011 PR-014 and work item 017 OCX-020 so release work does not deepen the Electron-only path.

Add automated validation for the shared-shell bridge and Tauri targets, including renderer interaction tests, desktop shell smoke tests, mobile decision-flow tests or documented emulator/device evidence, and rollback notes.
